evidence.exact_span: 126 However, in view of my finding that none of the s 255 notices and the s 260-5 Notices imposes a statutory obligation on the addressee(s) in accordance with its terms, it follows that the Deputy Commissioner is not entitled to the declaratory relief sought in her cross-claim, namely the relief set out at [7](1) --- (5), supra. The cross-claim must be dismissed.
